question: When is Prevention of Blindness Week observed in India?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**April 1 to April 7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prevention Of Blindness Week: 1-7 April.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Prevention of Blindness Week** is observed in India from **April 1 to April 7** every year to raise awareness about blindness prevention and encourage eye check-ups.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative is in collaboration with organizations like **Sight Savers** and **Rotary International**.

 
 
• 
 
India is often referred to as the **"blind capital of the world** due to the high number of people with visual impairments.

 
 
• 
 
India was the **first country** to seek a subsidized loan from the **World Bank’s International Development Agency** to address blindness.

 
 
• 
 
The week promotes **routine eye check-ups** and the adoption of **healthy habits** for vision care.

 
 
• The National Society for the Prevention of Blindness was founded in 1960 by Jawaharlal Nehru and Raj Kumari Amrit Kaur under the Societies Registration Act of 1860.
